summary.text: John Huot is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 56B, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2019, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican Andrew Hattaway is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: John Huot won re-election in 2020, 2022 and 2024, most recently defeating Republican Angeline Anderson on November 5, 2024.
Huot's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Commerce Finance and Policy Committee, the Health Finance and Policy Committee and the House Taxes Committee.
